betterinventory.configuration.title: Better Inventory Options
betterinventory.configuration.enabled.to: Show the hovered item enlarged in a frame right of the inventory. It only appears when the window is wide enough for it, and for a recipe viewer beside it if one is installed.
betterinventory.configuration.scale.tool: How large the item in the zoom frame is drawn.
betterinventory.configuration.backpackPl: Allow placing backpacks in the world with sneak + right click. Turn off so backpacks only work equipped in the inventory.
betterinventory.configuration.backpackOp: Allow opening held or placed backpacks with right click. Turn off so backpacks are only usable through the inventory tabs.
VANILLA keeps 64-stacks and upgrades grant 96-1024. HUNDRED rebases 64-stacks to 100 and upgrades grant 200-999.
betterinventory.configuration.magnetRadi: Pull radius (blocks) of the Level V Magnet Upgrade. Lower levels scale down from this.
betterinventory.configuration.feedingThr: The Level V Feeding Upgrade eats when hunger is at or below this (out of 20). Each lower level triggers 3 points later.
betterinventory.configuration.strongLock: Draw an x on crafting cells your upgrade has not unlocked. Off uses a plain faint dim.

screen.betterinventory.armor_swap: Swap the worn armor with the stored set
